priorities.summary: MariaDB server remote code execution via the #mysql50# table-name bypass prefix, affecting 10.6.1 through 13.0.2 releases; disclosed Oct 16, with fixed versions published including 10.6.28, 11.8.9 and 13.0.2.

iFlytek astron-agent agentic workflow platform ships unsandboxed Python execution in its default code-node path, allowing an authenticated low-privilege tenant to run code as root and cross tenant boundaries; fixed in 1.1.2.

Cisco Secure Email Gateway (ESA) relative path traversal in the AMP attachment engine lets an unauthenticated attacker write arbitrary files and execute commands as root; Cisco confirms active in-the-wild exploitation and CISA added it to the KEV catalog on Oct 14.

model.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
model.summary: DeepSeek's updated Flash-class model launched Oct 17, scoring 77% on DeepSWE 1.1 — topping Opus 5.0 and GPT-class rivals on coding and agentic benchmarks while cutting per-task costs with shorter, harness-optimized outputs.
